mass.title: The client served itself
mass.description: Build self-service support: new companies get started on their own.
mass.tradeoff: Replaces personal support. Hosting +$32 per sprint.

premium.title: Now that is enterprise
premium.description: Personal support for larger contracts: companies pay for your attention.
premium.tradeoff: Replaces mass support. Hosting +$96 per sprint.

batch.title: Your answer was ready yesterday
batch.description: Collect requests into batches and run the model once for the whole group.
batch.tradeoff: Replaces instant answers. Clients wait one sprint less.

instant.title: While you were typing
instant.description: Instant answers make clients recommend the product and wait longer for improvements.
instant.tradeoff: Replaces batches. Tokens +20%, hosting +$48 per sprint.

leads.title: Someone noticed us in a chat
leads.description: Prepare a demo for four new companies.
leads.tradeoff: Potential clients need free seats and a working product.

consulting.title: One tiny consulting job
consulting.description: A side project pays for the next product improvements.
consulting.tradeoff: Six work from the shared queue. A one-time payment.

credits.title: Provider credits
credits.description: Apply for an infrastructure grant: the provider pays for the next project.
credits.tradeoff: Three work from the shared queue. A one-time payment.
